transcription: I bought a one-way ticket to Bali after my fiancé dumped me. One week ago, a 28-female had a wedding venue booked, a $3,000 wedding dress hanging in my closet, and a Pinterest board with 78 pins labeled, Jays Ever After. Today, I'm at JFK with a backpack and no return ticket. A few hours from this post, I'll be on a plane to Bali, using the leave I saved up for our honeymoon. I don't know when I'm coming back. My family thinks I've lost my mind. My fiancé 29 million, from this point known as, X, of 8 years called off our wedding last week. Three months before the date. 8 years of my life, gone because apparently, we got together too young, and he never had the chance to find himself. There was another woman of course. Yes, I lost it. I smashed things. I hit my X. I was effing mad. I am small and useless and it didn't do anything to X but I know it was wrong. I will seek therapy. But before that day, I've never as so much even said the four letter word out loud before. That was the kind of dormant I have always been my whole life. After my breakdown, my best friend became over to accompany me over the weekend. She brought wine, ice cream, and a metal trash can. She said we had two, burn crud. So the next day, we were on my rooftop at midnight, feeding our relationship artifacts to a flame ritual. Wedding magazines, the stupid, love coupons, I've made him for Valentine's Day, every piece of evidence of our relationship. Into the flames they went. Be said too, go somewhere I have never been. To become someone he's never met. That's how I ended up booking a one-way ticket to Bali at 2am while drunk on cheap wine and rage. I found the Pinterest board I'd been building for years. Rice terraces, black sand beaches, temples in the jungle. Places I'd always wanted to see but never suggested because X thought Asia was too dangerous. Then I made a bucket list of everything I was too scared to do one. People alone to a foreign country too. Stay at a hostel not a hotel three. Tell people exactly what I think without softening it for. Say, no, without explaining Y5. Maybe have casual sex for once in my life I've only been with my X6. Do what I love right again in progress, hence I've starting writing on this account I've never traveled alone before. I don't know anyone in Bali. I've booked a hostel bed and hopefully get to make some friends. I've not made a new friend in years. Six months ago, this would have been my nightmare. But B was right, sometimes you have to burn everything down to see what rises from the ashes. My X wanted to find himself. Fine. I'm going to find myself too. I spent eight years trying to be the perfect girlfriend, always putting his needs first. I turned down jobs, friendships, opportunities because they didn't fit into his vision of what our life should look like. Well, that life doesn't exist anymore.
